parsed.rationale: After the last release, the analytics dashboard takes 30–45 seconds to load instead of under 5 seconds, slowing daily planning for 25 users (eventually loads). This indicates a performance regression likely needing engineering support.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—thanks for reporting this. We understand that after the most recent release, the analytics dashboard is now taking ~30–45 seconds to load (previously under 5 seconds) and is impacting daily planning for your operations team (though it does eventually load).

To help us narrow down what changed and what’s driving the slowdown, could you share the following details?
1) The exact release identifier/version (and deployment date/time, if available) for the “last release.”
2) Whether this slowdown happens in production for all users or only specific users/regions.
3) Whether it’s consistent on every dashboard load or intermittent.
4) Any relevant error messages or console/network details you can copy from a slow load attempt (or screenshots). If you have monitoring screenshots/metrics (e.g., server response times or client console errors) that would also help.
5) Whether other pages/APIs are also slower or this is limited to the analytics dashboard.

Once we have that, we’ll escalate to our engineering team to investigate the performance regression and advise on next steps.
promised_actions: Escalate to the engineering team to investigate the reported performance regression
safety_notes: Did not promise a specific fix, timeline, root cause, or any refund.
Asked for minimum useful clarification (release identifier, environment scope, consistency, logs/console/network details, and whether the issue is limited to the dashboard).
Acknowledged engineering escalation without claiming resolution.
